title: Water Margin (Outlaws of the Marsh)
author: Shi Nai'an
protagonist: The 108 outlaws collectively (Song Jiang as their face)

beats.event: The 108 spirits are released from beneath an ancient stele-bearing tortoise
Grand Marshal Gao Qiu abuses power and oppresses commoners
Persecution drives Shi Jin, Lu Zhishen, and Lin Chong toward rebellion
Lin Chong, framed by Gao Qiu, flees to Liangshan Marsh
Chao Gai's seven rob a birthday convoy meant for Cai Jing
Chao Gai becomes first chief of the outlaws at Mount Liang
Song Jiang's own arc unfolds separately from the band
Wu Song's extended story runs toward the marsh
Soldiers, officials, and specialists keep converging on Liangshan
Chao Gai is killed attacking the Zeng Family Fortress
Song Jiang succeeds Chao Gai as leader of the band
The full complement of 108 heroes is finally assembled
Great victory over the imperial army sent against Liangshan Marsh
Emperor Huizong grants the outlaws amnesty and imperial service
Conscripted to campaign against Liao invaders in the north
Campaign against Fang La grinds the band down heavily
At least two-thirds of the 108 die across the campaigns
Survivors take imperial honors or retire quietly as commoners
Song Jiang is poisoned by the Four Treacherous Ministers
